scope: OANDA forex research and shadow forecasting only
source_inventory_note: Catalogue, adapter, runtime, smoke qualification, market qualification, and production eligibility are separate evidence levels.
common_acceptance_gates: pair, timeframe, horizon, feature, data-cutoff, and model-version provenance
calibration, Brier score, signed error, MAE, net pips, drawdown, and coverage
minimum independent matured outcomes and time blocks
matched simple baseline on untouched windows
independent shadow monitoring before practice-account eligibility

shared_panel.market_evidence: The canonical panel contains 4,416,423 unique events over 68 instruments, 13 input timeframes, and 16 exact outcome horizons. It has all 208 timeframe-horizon cells, 14,102 observed pair-cells, 42 explicitly documented quote-unavailable pair-cells, and zero unaccounted contract gaps. The remaining-gap validation retained a contiguous tail of up to 64 events per observed pair/timeframe/horizon cell: 876,369 events across all 208 cells and all 14,102 observed pair-cells.
shared_panel.new_neural_smoke: PatchTST, N-BEATS, N-HiTS, LSTM, GRU, TCN, and the temporal cross-pair GNN have maturity-purged, observed-cost market backtests across the 208-cell contract. Aggregate LSTM and TCN economics initially cleared the old global-only gate, but each was positive in only 85/208 cells. The gate now also requires broad cell activity, a positive majority of active cells, and a positive majority of active timeframes; neither result is account eligible.
shared_panel.storage_note: The user-directed canonical runtime and rolling data are on D:\forex. The disk retains a known bad-sector history, so zero recent Event ID 7 records must not be interpreted as repaired hardware. Avoid unnecessary bulk rewrites, retain reproducible raw data on D, and sync credential-free source, model metadata, reports, summaries, and manifests to the OneDrive vault.

phases.evidence: CatBoost and NGBoost ran with logistic and histogram-gradient baselines on 150,000 stratified events spanning all 68 instruments, 13 timeframes, and 16 horizons. All four artifacts are hash verified and research-shadow only. No estimator passed the executable production gate.
phases.next_gate: Repeat across independent later time blocks and require a positive lower confidence bound, stable fold economics, and adequate coverage.

phases.evidence: All eight neural forecasters have chronological observed-cost market evidence. PatchTST, N-BEATS, N-HiTS, LSTM, GRU, and TCN were rerun across all 208 cells. LSTM and TCN showed positive aggregate economics but failed the strengthened cross-cell stability gate because only 85/208 cells were positive. TFT and DeepAR were trained on the 150,000-event, 22-panel input with CUDA; broad holdout AUC was 0.6396 and 0.5699 respectively, with zero executable selections. A separate 556,475-event H1/H4 supplement covered all 32 cells for those timeframes, including every required 1h, 4h, 12h, and 24h cell; supplemental AUC was 0.5678 and 0.5432. All source and checkpoint hashes verify. Production and account eligibility remain false.
phases.next_gate: Use an audited CUDA runtime for larger purged multi-origin fits and require positive cost-adjusted stability against matched simple baselines.

phases.evidence: Chronos-2, TimesFM-2.5, Moirai, Moirai-MoE, Tiny Time Mixer, Toto-2, and the official Lag-Llama checkpoint are revision-pinned locally and scored on the identical observed-bid/ask fixture. All seven were negative after spread; TimesFM-ICF remains separate and blocked because no audited public runtime was found.
phases.next_gate: Use a larger untouched multi-pair fixture and compare frozen forecasts to naive and fitted baselines before any fine-tuning.

phases.evidence: Graph edges use observations strictly before the forecast cutoff and include lagged correlation plus currency exposure. The temporal cross-pair GNN completed 208 independent cell fits across the full timeframe/horizon contract with no cell error; aggregate selected economics remained negative after observed costs.
phases.next_gate: Expand to multiple cells and compare against matched non-graph sequence baselines before shadow-signal eligibility.

phases.evidence: Pinned S4 commit e757cef57d89e448c413de7325ed5601 trained in the common maturity-purged sequence harness across the 208-cell sampled panel and failed the executable performance gate. Official Mamba still requires a compatible Linux/CUDA build; no substitute was used.
phases.next_gate: Retest S4 with accelerated kernels and move Mamba to a compatible isolated host before qualification.

phases.evidence: Contextual bandit, PPO, SAC, and DQN were fit only in fixed offline replay using complete observed SHORT/FLAT/LONG rewards and a maturity-purged holdout spanning all 208 cells. None passed the full cost-aware stability gate; no policy can reach a broker.
phases.next_gate: Keep as shadow allocators and require off-policy stability plus positive net value over the train-selected static-action baseline.

phases.evidence: Masked reconstruction, temporal contrastive, multi-task, frozen transfer, and teacher/student distillation were trained with train-only normalization and scored on untouched windows spanning the 208-cell sampled panel. All passed backtest integrity; none passed the spread-adjusted stability gate.
phases.next_gate: Measure incremental executable value over matched raw-feature baselines across independent time blocks before any shadow-signal use.
